controls.description: Work performed this period remained within approved SOW scope (or a formal change request exists).
Material scope/timeline/commitment changes followed documented change control and approvals.
Milestones and due dates are current, and slippage (if any) is documented with mitigations.
Deliverables completed this period have evidence of review/acceptance where applicable.
Risks/issues are tracked, up to date, and owners/mitigations are identified for material items.
Key stakeholders were informed of material status changes, risks, and decisions.
SOW approval state and any required monthly attestations are current and documented.
Evidence referenced for attestations is traceable to the provided project context/deltas (no invention).
